name: Vulpecula
introduction: is the Little Fox, introduced by Johannes Hevelius in 1687 as a fox carrying a goose. It lies in the Milky Way between Cygnus and Aquila.

sections.title: What makes it special
paragraphs: The first pulsar was discovered in Vulpecula. In 1967, Jocelyn Bell Burnell noticed regular radio pulses, which turned out to come from a spinning neutron star.
The Dumbbell Nebula, M27, was the first planetary nebula discovered, by Charles Messier in 1764.

sections.title: Notable stars
paragraphs: [Anser](hip:95771), Alpha Vulpeculae, is a red giant. [15 Vulpeculae](hip:98543) is a white giant.

sections.title: Beyond the stars
paragraphs: Brocchi’s Cluster, the Coathanger, is an asterism of stars shaped like a coat hanger.
